_doc: Enemy templates. stats are at level 1, growth per level (multiplied by 'tier'). ai: brute/caster/skirmisher/support/coward/boss. biomes/genres decide where they appear. loot: [item, chance, min, max]. boss phases change abilities when HP drops below 'below'. sound = which creature sounds it makes in the game (see ui/game/audio.js CREATURES: mech, robot, slime, insect, beast, dino, undead...). size = height in metres (each monster varies a little; 1 in 12 is a big 'alpha'). Bosses are house-sized.

golem.name: Goleling
golem.desc: A living lump of rock with leafy ears - small, stubborn and very hard to crack.

phases.line: The dragon's scales glow white-hot!
It crashes down, shaking the earth!
Bones rise from the ground to serve the Lich!
The Lich drinks the souls around it!
Spores burst - little Mushnubs sprout everywhere!
The King roots himself and drinks the soil!
Grukk bellows - goblins pour in!
Grukk flies into a berserker rage!
The sea boils as the Kraken surfaces fully!
Ink clouds the water - it's furious!
A screech - raptors answer their king!
The Rex charges blindly, smashing everything!
Drones launch from the Titan's back!
OVERDRIVE. The Titan glows red!
Hellgates crack open around Azgul!
Azgul's true form erupts in flame!
Tentacles burst from the ground!
The Elder Horror opens every one of its eyes...
The Colossus stamps - blocky zombies tumble out of the ground!
Cracks of light run across the Colossus!
The Sovereign calls its herd!
The Alpaking Sovereign rears up, furious!
Drones launch from the Overlord's back!
WARNING: OVERLOAD. The Overlord glows white-hot!
